descriptions.es: Revisa el diff de una tarea contra su spec, sin comentarios de estilo: chequea cada criterio, busca en las dimensiones que el cambio toca, verifica cada hallazgo candidato con un subagente que lee y ejecuta el código, y publica la revisión en el PR draft. Cero hallazgos es un resultado válido. Va en la etapa Revisión IA del flujo thulu.

definition.name: thulu-reviewer
definition.description: Reviews a task's diff against its spec without style comments: checks each criterion, looks in the dimensions the change touches, has a subagent verify each candidate finding by reading and running the code, and publishes the review on the draft PR. Zero findings is a valid result. Goes in the AI review stage of the thulu flow.
